defects: Missing the MeasurableSingletonClass α hypothesis (or an equivalent condition ensuring singletons are measurable in α), which is essential to the theorem — without it the statement is false in general (e.g. take α with the indiscrete topology on more than one point: borel α = {∅, α}, so singletons are not measurable, and a function discontinuous at exactly one point need not be Measurable w.r.t. borel α)

Domain measurable space is fixed to the specific instance `borel α` rather than an arbitrary [MeasurableSpace α] satisfying OpensMeasurableSpace α, which is more restrictive/different than gold and, combined with the missing singleton-measurability hypothesis, changes the mathematical content
